name: Learned Graph Condensation
problem_statement: Learn a smaller synthetic attributed graph whose supervised training utility approximates that of the original training graph.

normalization: Preserve external vertex identities and isolated vertices.
Reject self-loops and collapse parallel edges only under the declared aggregation rule.

problem_inputs.name: synthetic_vertex_budget
problem_inputs.description: Positive number of synthetic vertices, at most the number of training vertices.

problem_inputs.name: method
problem_inputs.description: Condensation method, hyperparameters and training model.

problem_inputs.name: seed
problem_inputs.description: Seed for condensation and downstream evaluation.

required_outputs.name: synthetic_graph
required_outputs.description: Synthetic vertices, learned features/labels and declared weighted adjacency.

required_outputs.name: training_metadata
required_outputs.description: Method, seed, budgets, splits, preprocessing and model/checkpoint references.

required_outputs.name: utility_metrics
required_outputs.description: Downstream performance and variance on held-out original data under a fixed evaluation protocol.

solution_semantics.objective: Learn a smaller synthetic attributed graph whose supervised training utility approximates that of the original training graph.
solution_semantics.exactness: Learned approximation measured by held-out downstream utility, with no structural equivalence claim.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Each external vertex ID occurs once; output multiplicities follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No ordering among equally valid solutions is required.

validation_rules: Honor the synthetic vertex budget and feature/class dimensions.
Synthetic IDs are new identities; do not claim a quotient mapping from original vertices.
Fit on permitted training labels only; record transductive access to unlabeled topology/features.
Report downstream training/evaluation configuration and held-out metrics over declared seeds.
Verify finite features, valid labels, and adjacency under the declared symmetry/weight convention.
edge_cases: Condensation need not preserve original edges or graph cuts.
Very small budgets may not represent every class.
A utility estimate does not prove an exact structural approximation.

correctness: Honor the synthetic vertex budget and feature/class dimensions.
Synthetic IDs are new identities; do not claim a quotient mapping from original vertices.

Verify finite features, valid labels, and adjacency under the declared symmetry/weight convention.
